bibliographic.title: See You Around
bibliographic.author: Lacey Louwagie
bibliographic.description:
It's the last weekend of November 1995, and Jasmira is short on the rent. But she knows how to bring in $200 within a night.

She doesn't expect to find Alim — the man she dumped two months ago — performing a song that rips her apart to a bar full of strangers. Work will have to wait.

When Alim goes home with her that night, he learns how much he didn't know about the woman who broke his heart.

This is a hypertext literary fiction short story told across two pivotal nights months apart, with original songs embedded as lyrics in the text.

Content warning: Content warning: frequent profanity, alcohol and drug use, a non-explicit reference to sexual exploitation, and one explicit sexual encounter between consenting adults.
